test_pytest_addoption: test the pytest_addoption hook to add a --runslow CLI flag to pytest
test_pytest_collection_modifyitems: test the pytest_collection_modifyitems hook to skip slow tests unless --runslow is provided
run_pytest_with_slow: run pytest with the --runslow option to include slow-marked tests in the test suite
create_conftest_hook: create a conftest.py hook that adds custom CLI options to pytest via pytest_addoption
review_pytest_hooks: review the pytest hook functions pytest_addoption and pytest_collection_modifyitems
